label: The square-root-of-kappa bound
subgoals: Take the square root of the condition number
Form the ratio of root kappa minus one to root kappa plus one
Raise it to the iteration count and double it

label: Iterations needed for a tolerance
subgoals: Set two rho to the k equal to the tolerance
Round up to the next whole iteration

label: Why power grids are ill-conditioned
subgoals: Relate the condition number to the inverse square of the mesh spacing
Scale iterations with the square root of kappa
Multiply by the refinement factor to estimate the new count
